summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting that Moody's Ratings and S&P Global Ratings assigned Baa3 and BBB ratings, respectively, to its USD 300 million Senior Unsecured Fixed Rate Notes issued under its USD 7.5 billion Global Medium Term Note Programme. This is a routine debt issuance notification, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, or other corporate event is involved. The filing merely discloses credit ratings on newly priced notes, with no impact on shareholders' equity or corporate control.
